Diagram
|-- Shared immutable value
|   |-- ~ readonly diagramId: string; readonly revisionId: string
|   |-- Service identity remains distinct from the local canvas content key.
|   |-- ~ readonly id: string; readonly revision: number
|   |-- Canvas, persistence and agents share this repository-independent value.
|   |-- ~ content: DeepReadonly<DiagramContent>; jumps?: DeepReadonly<DiagramJump[]>
|   `-- These data fields do not establish runtime resource ownership.
|-- Content structure
|   |-- ~ DiagramContent: revisionId + ascii + asciiSha256 + structure
|   |-- buildDiagramContent accepts printable ASCII with LF and a size limit.
|   |-- ~ structure.kind = 'diagram' | 'tree'
|   |-- Tree mode invokes parseAsciiTree and records roots, nodes and parser version.
|   |-- ~ node.id = revisionId + ':' + hash + ':line-' + line
|   |-- Node records capture text spans, parent/children and descendant fold ranges.
|   |-- ~ visibleContentLines(content, collapsedIds): number[]
|   `-- Visibility requires fold ranges; an unknown collapsed node throws STALE_CONTENT_NODE.
|-- Source evidence contract
|   |-- ~ sourceContext: DeepReadonly<DiagramSourceContext>
|   |-- The source context ties mappings and evidence to the content hash.
|   |-- ~ binding?: {sourceId, repositoryIdentity, corpus, domainProfileId}
|   |-- Bindings validate absolute corpus roots and compatible corpus/profile kinds.
|   |-- ~ mappings: readonly DiagramElementMapping[]; evidence: Record<string, ...>
|   `-- Each mapping must resolve an evidence entity and its indexed source range.
|-- Validation boundary
|   |-- ~ validateDiagram(diagram) -> buildDiagramContent(...) + asciiSha256(...)
|   |-- Canonical parsed content and source hashes must match the diagram.
|   |-- ~ validateDiagramJumps(content, jumps); validateDiagramLocalMappings(ascii, mappings)
|   `-- Evidence checks include relative paths, line bounds and captured original lines.
`-- Read-only source queries
    |-- ~ diagramSource(diagram) -> queryDiagramSourceContext(diagram.sourceContext)
    |-- All mapping/evidence joins are centralized at this boundary.
    |-- ~ evidence[mapping.entityId].sourceRanges[mapping.sourceRangeIndex]
    |-- Selection queries require mapping geometry; search uses IDs, labels, paths and symbols.
    `-- ~ mappings(); forSelection(rect); entries(); search(query)
